definition-dropped.answer: The rule's 'type' is 'the type of the function' (an intrinsic-function type of §2002:15.1), not the type that §2002:4 defines for a type declaration ('A template that contains all the characteristics of a data item and its subordinates', the same words as §2023:8.5.3.1); the dropped definition cannot change which programs the rule governs.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:15.1 differs from 2023 by saying, for alphanumeric and national functions, 'The number of character positions in this data item is specified in the function definition'; RV3 is that specification for MIN, so the 2002 text supports rather than changes it. An alphanumeric or national MIN computes no arithmetic result, so §2002:8.8.1.x is not involved; §2002:8.5.3/8.5.4/14.5.8 are reached only through the word 'type'. Evidence at --std 2002 (minf.cob, pb59_operand_category_total, cdargs.cob) stands.
